notes: Hard thresholds are collection/calibration gates, not production release. Reliability is diagnostic plus gating evidence — not a single global alpha.

preferredReviewedCharts.rationale: Preferred corpus size so school and cohort slices are not empty.

floorReviewedCharts.rationale: Absolute floor before GO_FOR_CALIBRATION. Below this, pairwise and reliability estimates are unstable.

minReviewedCaseSchoolNamPhai.rationale: Actual Nam Phái reviews, not eligibleSchools on the case.

minReviewedCaseSchoolTrungChau.rationale: Actual Trung Châu reviews. A Nam Phái review never counts as Trung Châu.

multiReviewerCaseSchoolCount.rationale: Count of (caseId, school) units with ≥2 independent reviewers and overlapping ratings. Global reviewer ID count is not a substitute.

minPairwiseComparisons.rationale: Enough directed comparisons to form a useful within-chart graph. Not a fitted Bradley–Terry model.

holdoutNonEmpty.rationale: Split is frozen before tuning. Empty holdout is documentation, not a usable split.

krippendorffMustBeComputable.rationale: Alpha is reported per axis and school. Insufficient overlap → null / NOT_COMPUTABLE. No fabricated alpha.

krippendorffSingleFloor.rationale: Do not use one global alpha cutoff as the only GO condition. Conventional 0.67 remains a diagnostic comment only.

cohortRequirements.vcd: Represent VCD charts where school VCD policy is sufficiently resolved (Trung Châu structural policy recorded; Nam Phái VCD unresolved — non-VCD Nam Phái cases still collectable).
cohortRequirements.structuralSystem: Represent at least one chart tagged structural-system once enough cases exist.
